name: typewright-website-audit
description: Free small-business website audit: speed, mobile, findability, trust, and accessibility checks.
long_description: One MCP tool, `audit_website`, runs Typewright Studio's scored checks on a business homepage. Results include speed (Google PageSpeed), mobile, Google findability, trust and contact, and accessibility basics, each with a cited source. Free, no API key. The URL you submit is sent to typewrightstudio.com and Google PageSpeed; neither the URL nor the results are stored.

tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Run Typewright Studio's website audit on a business homepage URL.

include_cta.title: Include project CTA
include_cta.description: When true, successful audits may include a one-line Typewright Studio project link in the report.
